_extraction_flags.notes: BORDERLINE: This is about Optical Transport Network optimizing RF-ISAC services, NOT optical sensing+communication. The optical network transports IQ echo streams from RF BSs to MEC servers. Sensing is RF-based (5G-NR OFDM radar at 3.4 GHz). Optical component is purely transport/networking, not ISAC sensing.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: Architecture shows optical transport network (access/aggregation switches) connecting RF Base Stations (USRP B210/N310) to MEC servers. 5G-NR OFDM at 3.4 GHz. Range-velocity maps from RF echo processing. Fig.2: Network utilization vs sensing policies comparison.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: RF-ISAC (5G-NR passive radar) with optical transport network for IQ stream delivery. Sensing: RF echo-based object detection via OFDM radar. Communication: 5G-NR fronthaul/backhaul. Optical's role: Transport infrastructure, NOT sensing medium. SDN orchestration optimizes routing for both IQ sensing and comm streams.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: RF sensing at 3445 MHz, 10 MHz BW. Object detection at 200-400m range. IQ stream throughput: ~200 Mbps (1 BS) to ~550 Mbps (3 BSs). Network utilization: Optimal policy ~0.66 vs All-Active ~0.85. Echo SNR gain: ~2.96 dB for optimal. All-optical fast switch for low latency.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: SDN-orchestrated optical transport network optimization for ISAC services. Novel 'optimal' routing policy reduces network utilization by 30% while maintaining sensing quality. Gap: This is network-layer optimization, NOT O-ISAC. The sensing and communication are RF-based, optical is only transport medium.

bibliographic.title: Optical Transport Network Optimization Supporting Integrated Sensing and Communication Services
bibliographic.authors: Markos Anastasopoulos, Jesús Gutiérrez, Anna Tzanakaki

application.scenario_description: 6G ISAC network where optical transport network interconnects RAN (RF BSs) with MEC servers for joint communication and sensing service support.

key_contribution.key_contribution: SDN-orchestrated optical transport network optimization for RF-ISAC services. 'Optimal' dynamic routing policy selectively transports high-SNR IQ echo streams, reducing network utilization by 30% while maintaining sensing accuracy.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Previous ISAC work focused on RF signal processing; this addresses transport network optimization for IQ echo stream delivery.

transmitter.notes: RF transmitter: 5G-NR OFDM at 3445 MHz (sub-6GHz), 10 MHz bandwidth. USRP B210/N310 SDR. Optical transport: 1/10/40/100 GbE links.

receiver.notes: RF sensing receiver processes IQ echo streams at MEC servers. Optical network uses optoelectronic and all-optical fast switches.

integration.notes: RF generates ISAC signals. Optical only transports IQ streams. Sensing and comm streams share optical network capacity via SDN optimization.

waveform.notes: 5G-NR OFDM serves as passive OFDM radar. Echoes from objects are collected and transported via optical network to MEC for processing.

channel_wireless.notes: RF wireless channel emulated via GNU Radio. Object detection at 200-400m range. SNR threshold determines which echo streams are used.

comm_metrics.notes: IQ stream throughput: 200-550 Mbps depending on number of active BSs. Fronthaul/backhaul requirements not explicitly stated.

sensing_metrics.notes: RF-based passive radar using 5G-NR echoes. Range-velocity maps generated. Object detection accuracy improves with multi-BS fusion.

tradeoff.notes: Optimal policy: ~0.66 network utilization, ~2.96 dB echo gain. All-Active: ~0.85 utilization, ~3.0 dB gain. 30% efficiency improvement with optimal routing.
